entities.summary: Ghassan Alian is an Israeli-Druze officer in the IDF holding the rank of Aluf. Alian served as the head of the Coordinator of Government Activities in the Territories, Central Command's executive officer and head of the Israeli Civil Administration. Alian is one of the highest ranking Druze Arabs in the IDF and has served since 1990.
